description: This file defines a web scraping tool class 'WebScraperRecursiveTool' that can scrape web pages recursively or via sitemap, extracting titles, descriptions, and paragraph texts. It also includes a node class 'WebScraperRecursive_Tools' for integration with a node-based system, allowing configuration of scraping parameters.

classes.name: WebScraperRecursiveTool
classes.description: A class that performs recursive web scraping or sitemap-based scraping, extracting page metadata and links.

classes.name: WebScraperRecursive_Tools
classes.description: A node class that initializes and configures the WebScraperRecursiveTool with user-defined parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node class with parameters and creates an instance of WebScraperRecursiveTool.
